entities.name: Audrey
entities.description: One of the two speakers, a city dweller whose life revolves around her four small dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie. She hikes, cooks, gardens, makes and sells jewellery from recycled objects and has two tattoos of her dogs on her arm. She moved to a house with a bigger backyard in June 2023 and took dog training, agility and grooming courses through 2023, joining a dog owners group in November. She had a knee injury before the conversation and broke her arm in October 2023. A friend of Andrew's who encourages his search for a dog and a dog-friendly flat.

entities.name: Andrew
entities.description: One of the two speakers, a Financial Analyst who started that job in March 2023 and lives in a city apartment with his girlfriend. He loves nature, hiking, birds and eagles in particular, and spent March to July 2023 searching for a dog and a dog-friendly place to live before getting the puppy Toby on 11 July 2023, Buddy in October and Scout in November. Work stress kept him indoors for much of the autumn. A friend of Audrey's.

entities.name: Andrew's girlfriend
entities.description: Andrew's partner, never named in the conversation and referred to as 'my girl', 'my girlfriend', 'my GF' and 'the gf'. She shares nearly all of his outings: cafes, a farm, a picnic, fishing, camping with Toby, a wine tasting, board games, a bike ride, and volunteering at a pet shelter. She is a co-owner of Toby, Buddy and Scout.

properties.aliases: my girl; my GF; the gf

entities.name: Audrey's dogs
entities.description: Audrey's pack, three dogs until April 2023 (Pepper, Precious, Panda) and four after the puppy Pixie was adopted on 2 April 2023. Referred to throughout as 'my pups', 'my fur babies', 'my furry friends', 'the doggos' and 'my little family'. All mutts; Audrey described them as two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes in July and September 2023 and as two Lab mixes and two Chihuahua mixes in October 2023. Three years old as of July 2023. They do agility twice a week, know sit, stay, shake and roll over, love fetch and frisbee, and hate snow. They saw an animal behaviourist in October 2023 after behaving oddly.

properties.aliases: my pups; my fur babies; my furry friends; the doggos; my little family; my four pups

entities.name: Pepper
entities.description: One of Audrey's dogs, with her since about 2020. Took a while to get used to the puppy Pixie in April 2023 and then became inseparable from her. Loves lounging on the couch. Audrey called her a Jack Russell mix in July 2023 and a Lab mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Precious
entities.description: One of Audrey's dogs, with her since about 2020. Has her own chair to relax in. Andrew identified her as the dog whose leash snapped at the park on 22 September 2023. Audrey called her a Chihuahua mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Panda
entities.description: One of Audrey's dogs, with her since about 2020, referred to as 'he'. Likes to relax on his rug. Audrey called him a Lab mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Pixie
entities.description: A white puppy Audrey adopted on 2 April 2023, making her the fourth of Audrey's dogs. Took a few days to settle in with the other three and then became close friends with them, especially Pepper. Curls up in her own bed. Audrey called her a Chihuahua mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Fox Hollow
entities.description: A hiking trail Andrew recommended to Audrey on 27 March 2023 as a good weekend hike with great views. Audrey said she would try it but had still not been by 2 April 2023 because the new puppy was keeping her busy.

entities.name: The park near Audrey's home
entities.description: The unnamed park Audrey walks her dogs in, referred to as 'the park', 'the park near me', 'our local park' and 'the park we usually walk'. It is where she recharges, where she lets the dogs off the leash, where she plays fetch and meets other dog owners, where a leash snapped on 22 September 2023 and where she had the accident that broke her arm in October 2023. A dog park sits right beside it.

properties.aliases: the park near me; our local park; the park we usually walk

entities.name: The dog park near Audrey's home
entities.description: An unnamed dog park right beside the park Audrey usually walks her dogs in, with trees and benches. Audrey uses it for playdates, took the dogs there on 30 September 2023, and started agility classes there in August 2023. She calls it paradise for her dogs. Andrew said in May 2023 that it was not far from him and that he would check it out.

entities.name: Hiking
entities.description: The activity both speakers care most about. Andrew calls nature a home for his soul, hikes at least once a weekend when work allows, and photographs the views; Audrey hikes with her four dogs. They spent from July 2023 onward planning a joint hike with the dogs, first for August, then November, and finally fixed for Saturday 4 November 2023 on a dog-friendly trail by a lake.

entities.name: Bird-watching
entities.description: Andrew has been awed by birds, eagles above all, since before March 2023 and spots them while hiking, though he had never gone out bird-watching specifically as of 27 March 2023. He owns binoculars and reads about ecosystems. Audrey decided in October 2023 that she wanted to take it up, bought a bird-watching guide book, and they agreed to plan a trip together.

entities.name: Cooking
entities.description: A hobby both speakers share. Andrew took it up around July 2023 because he could not get out hiking, and uses it to de-stress and be creative. Audrey loves experimenting with recipes; her favourites are a family Chicken Pot Pie and a Mediterranean-style Roasted Chicken, and garlic is her go-to ingredient. Audrey also bakes muffins and cookies.

entities.name: Rock climbing
entities.description: Andrew took a rock climbing class with friends on 11 June 2023, reached the top, and said he was hooked and wanted to do more outdoor activities like it every week.

entities.name: Audrey's dog training course
entities.description: A positive reinforcement dog training class Audrey found on a flyer at her local pet store and signed up for on 11 May 2023 for the following month, described then as a workshop on bonding with her pets. Joined here with the 'dog training course' she said she was taking on 3 July 2023, which she called challenging, rewarding and a big time sink, because the dates and the subject match. Her dogs were doing better as a result, and she went back to positive reinforcement techniques on the behaviourist's advice in October 2023.

properties.aliases: the workshop about bonding with my pet; positive reinforcement training class; the dog-training course

entities.name: Audrey's local pet store
entities.description: The unnamed pet store near Audrey. She saw the flyer for the positive reinforcement training class there in May 2023 and met a volunteer's friendly dog in the shop; she went back on 16 October 2023 to buy toys for her dogs.

entities.name: Andrew's search for a dog and a dog-friendly home
entities.description: Andrew's long-running effort, from April 2023 onward, to find both a dog and a place in the city that allows one. He browsed rental websites, contacted landlords, walked neighbourhoods and visited shelters, wanting somewhere near a park or woods. He got the puppy Toby on 11 July 2023 while still searching for the flat, and as late as 6 September 2023 he said he had still not found a dog-friendly place; by November 2023 he had three dogs and said he had managed to make it work in the city.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Audrey's childhood dog, full of energy and a lover of fetch. She took him on long walks around the neighbourhood as a girl, exploring new paths, and confided her worries and hopes in him; she called those days some of her favourite memories.

entities.name: Toby
entities.description: Andrew's German Shepherd puppy, taken home on 11 July 2023 and his first pet. Still too young to hike as of September 2023. He went camping with Andrew and his girlfriend in August 2023, likes cute sweaters, once chased a squirrel round a tree at the dog park, and was joined by Buddy in October 2023 and Scout in November 2023.

entities.name: Dog grooming
entities.description: Audrey learned to groom her own dogs during August 2023 on a dog grooming course, and says doing it herself brings her closer to them. Her routine is daily brushing, regular baths and nail trims, done slowly and gently with attention to ears and paws. She still uses a pet salon occasionally, taking the dogs there on 17 November 2023. Andrew has always wanted to learn it and had still not taken his own dogs to a groomer by 22 November 2023.

entities.name: Gardening
entities.description: Audrey keeps a small garden with flowers — Peruvian Lilies, which she says are easy to care for — and a vegetable patch, and her dogs run around in it. Andrew tends a balcony full of flowers, which he described on 24 September 2023, and Audrey suggested in October 2023 that he get more plants for his home to bring some peace indoors.

entities.name: Audrey's dog grooming course
entities.description: The course Audrey took to learn to groom her own dogs, which she described on 19 August 2023 as where she learned lots of techniques. It is the 'new skill' that made her August eventful.

entities.name: Audrey's dog agility classes
entities.description: Agility classes Audrey started with her four dogs at a dog park on 4 August 2023. She takes them twice a week to practise; she calls it a great physical and mental workout, a bonding experience and tough at times, and enjoys watching them build relationships with the other dogs.

entities.name: The pet shelter Andrew volunteered at
entities.description: An unnamed pet shelter where Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered on 24 July 2023. He called it one of the most rewarding things he has ever done and his way of giving back to animals.

entities.name: Buddy
entities.description: Andrew's second dog, adopted from a shelter shortly before 19 October 2023 and named Buddy because he is Andrew's buddy and because Andrew hoped he and Toby would become buddies. He was still getting used to Toby and to his new home in October, enjoys walks with Andrew and loves checking out new hiking trails.

entities.name: Scout
entities.description: Andrew's third dog, adopted a few days before 22 November 2023. He and his girlfriend took a while to settle on the name Scout, choosing it for the dog's adventurous spirit. Scout was being kept on a leash outdoors while getting used to things, and had a bed, toys and puppy pads of his own; his first outing was to be a nearby park with Toby and Buddy.

entities.name: Audrey's recycled jewellery making
entities.description: Audrey makes one-of-a-kind jewellery out of recycled objects she hunts down — bottle caps, buttons and broken jewellery — which she describes as combining creativity with sustainability and reducing waste. It began as a hobby and she went on to sell the pieces, donating a portion of the profits to an animal shelter.

entities.name: Audrey's dog owners group
entities.description: A group of dog owners Audrey joined shortly before 4 November 2023 to learn to take better care of her dogs. She meets the other owners about once a week for tips from other dog parents and so that the dogs can play together.

entities.name: The animal shelter Audrey donates to
entities.description: An unnamed animal shelter to which Audrey donates a portion of the profits from the jewellery she sells. She said on 6 October 2023 that they do great work and that donating is her way of helping out, since she cannot be there in person.

entities.name: Audrey's knee injury
entities.description: An injury Audrey had at some point before October 2023 that stopped her walking her dogs. She said on 6 October 2023 that it was tough because they bring her so much joy, and that it felt great to get back out there once she could walk them again.

entities.name: Audrey's arm injury
entities.description: An injury Audrey suffered in an accident while playing with her dogs at the park in the week before 24 October 2023, which left her arm in a cast. Caring for four dogs with one arm was tricky but she was managing, and she said she was feeling better each day.

claims.text: Andrew went from having no pets and hunting for both a dog and a dog-friendly flat in spring 2023 — browsing websites, contacting landlords and visiting shelters — to owning three dogs by late November 2023: Toby on 11 July, Buddy in October and Scout in November, all while still living in the city.
claims.speaker: Andrew

claims.text: Audrey's household grew from three dogs to four when Pixie was adopted on 2 April 2023, and she trained and cared for them progressively through the year: a positive reinforcement course from June 2023, agility classes from August, dog grooming she learned herself in August, and an animal behaviourist in October when they began behaving oddly.
claims.speaker: Audrey

claims.text: The hike Andrew and Audrey planned to take together with their dogs was first proposed in July 2023 for the following month, still unarranged and pushed to November when they spoke in October, and finally fixed on 28 October 2023 for Saturday 4 November on a dog-friendly trail by a lake.
claims.speaker: Audrey
